card.name: Link and citation punctuation
card.fires_on: Punctuation right before a web address or DOI code, such as the colon after doi or the :// after http. Also fires on some small linking words like of, the, to inside ordinary sentences.

modes.label: URL and DOI joints
modes.description: Colon or :// or a path piece just before the body of a web address or DOI number.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Short words like of, the, to, even in running prose where the next word is open.
modes.example: China will attempt<< to>> land an exploratory craft on the moon

card.plain: It fires at the break points in web links and citation codes, and weakly on some small linking words.
